inferential_scope: Within-matched-set association between pre-event environmental conditions and first-observed VNP14A1 fire detection in baseline-natural-forest cells; not a causal human-access, intent, plantation, or government-performance model.

design.estimator: conditional logistic regression with one case and four controls per matched set
design.uncertainty: two-way cluster-robust sandwich covariance by recurring cell and acquisition date; cell-only fallback is permitted only if the two-way covariance has an invalid diagonal and must be reported

pre_fit_data_quality_amendment.timing: after the first model command stopped during transform validation and before any coefficient was fitted
pre_fit_data_quality_amendment.trigger: one CHIRPS row contained the provider/export missing sentinel -9999, which is finite numerically but is not precipitation
pre_fit_data_quality_amendment.rule: exclude the entire five-row matched set if any member has a negative CHIRPS lag, EVI <= -9000, or a missing/non-finite required model covariate; never replace a sentinel with zero or impute from the other members
pre_fit_data_quality_amendment.reporting: publish excluded row and matched-set counts and retain the immutable source frame unchanged

transforms.era5_rootzone_soil_water_mean_72h: negative z score so larger values mean drier conditions

primary_hypothesis.contrast: ratio of within-set fire-detection odds ratios for a one-standard-deviation increase in dryness, comparing cells at or above versus below 50% peat extent

mandatory_sensitivities: repeat the primary model after excluding every matched set on a history-fallback event date
repeat the primary interaction using peat thresholds of 25% and 75%
repeat the primary model in the locked 2024-2025 test period only

multiplicity.primary: unadjusted two-sided p value and 95% confidence interval
multiplicity.secondary_condition_family: Holm correction across the three secondary peat-condition interactions
multiplicity.threshold_and_fallback_runs: robustness checks; they cannot replace or redefine the primary 50% soil-dryness result

prediction_metrics.primary: conditional log loss within each five-cell matched set
prediction_metrics.noninformative_metric: top-5 recall is always 1 with one case among five sampled cells and will be reported as structurally non-informative

interpretation_rules: Odds ratios are within matched sets and describe detectable fire association, not absolute fire probability or burned area.
A non-significant result is inconclusive, not proof of no effect.
Static peat extent is not peat moisture, drainage state, peat depth, or current land cover.
No result from this track identifies deliberate burning, plantation expansion, profit, government effort, or human-access causality.
Global generalization requires a separately harmonized observation-denominator analysis.
